Primary abstract: As embodied intelligence (EI), large language models (LLMs), and cloud computing continue to advance, Industry 5.0 facilitates the development of industrial artificial intelligence (IndAI) through cyber-physical-social systems (CPSSs) with a human-centric focus. These technologies are organized by the system-wide approach of Industry 5.0, in order to empower the manufacturing industry to achieve broader societal goals of job creation, economic growth, and green production.
